title: a builder's version bump merged at integration deadlocks the session on the pin gate
detail: tiered-solo-builder: the plan told backend-builder to bump prusik/__init__.py to 0.252.0 (and the README Action pin, to satisfy the pre-commit hook). The integrator merged it into main, and the pre-tool/stop pin gate (installed 0.251.0 < checkout 0.252.0) then refused every Bash/Edit/Write and Stop, both for the integrator (escalated permission_denied) and for the operator session. The only exit was a user '!' command reverting the line. release.sh owns the bump (fb-c713dc6530a9). The gate should stop a sprint from bumping the version: the plan schema/plan-critic and the builder specs say never bump, and a builder or merge that changes __version__ is refused at the boundary, not discovered at integration as a whole-session lockout.
